7.blog: Mini Candy and Plush Crane Machines are coming soon! Perfect for home use and all ages, these machines are suitable for all party sized confectionery, key rings, mini plush and novelty items.
7.long_description:
Mini Candy and Plush Crane Machines are coming soon! Perfect for home use and all ages, these machines are suitable for all party sized confectionery, key rings, mini plush and novelty items.

These mini crane machines contain all the fun of a full sized crane machine, and are the perfect size for bench tops or those who don't have the space for a full sized machine. They're a great talking point and novelty for parties, and are perfect for kids who can't get enough of candy crane machines.

The Mini Candy and Plush Crabe Machines will be available in 2020, with more information coming soon!
